title: .gitignore Generator
app_desc: Generate .gitignore from GitHub official template library
info_source: Data comes from github/gitignore. Pure frontend, no backend requests.
info_usage: Click a file on the left to add it to the selected list on the right (click again or use the × on the right to remove). The downloaded file is named git.gitignore; remove the git prefix and rename it to .gitignore.
load_failed: Failed to load template list. Please refresh.
file_note: File saved as {file}. Please remove the `git` prefix from the filename before using it.
fail_desc: The following templates could not be fetched. They will be skipped after confirmation:
